title: Egyptian Lamb Pasta
description: A simple and flavorful recipe that combines the richness of lamb with the simplicity of pasta.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat the bechamel sauce over medium heat.
Add the ground lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the dried herbs and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan and toss to combine with the lamb mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with parmesan cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
